{{Attr|Health Regen}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Sack Noob''' was an enemy that appeared in [[The Narratorium]] as a part of [[The Final Act Event]]. It had higher health than all the enemies that appear above it, but it was also slower than them. While it did not have it by default, it generally spawned with [[Aggro]]. ==Logbook Description== "''Sack Noob is designed to take punches. The stuffing inside dampens blows dealt and allows them to take a significant amount of damage. Many of the Sack Noob are hand-crafted by Righty, as it seems to enjoy the delicate process of stitching.''" ==Appearance== The '''Sack Noob''' is a plushie that resembles a stereotypical Roblox noob. It has yellow skin, blue torso and gren legs. On its torso, it has a zipper. It has two black button eyes and a giant open mouth with a visible tongue. It has two walking animations it can use. ==Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[The Narratorium]] is listed instead. *Early-game towers like the [[Crook Boss]], [[Golden Soldier]] or [[Golden Crook Boss]] are pretty useful here. **The [[Toxic Gunner]] and [[Electroshocker]] can be used to kill multiple at once. *Later on, the '''Sack Noob''' becomes rather weak, meaning most towers should be capable of defeating them, including late-game towers like the [[Accelerator]], [[Turret]], [[Ranger]] or [[Pursuit]]. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} SackNoobWalk.gif|Walking animation (20 December 2025 – Present) SackNoobWalk2.gif|Walking animation (20 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseSackNoob1.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, first animation variant (20 December 2025 – Present) CorpseSackNoob2.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version, second animation variant (20 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} V2.4.0GenericThumbnail8.png|'''Sack Noob''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} SackNoobIconIG.png|'''Sack Noob''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Sack Noob''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. *The design concept of the '''Sack Noob''' is likely inspired by ''Sackboy'' from the ''Little Big Planet'' franchise, with both having a zipper on their chest, black eyes and an open smiling mouth with a visible tongue in it. ==Update History== *'''20 December 2025''' - [[v1.83.0]]a **'''Sack Noob''' added. *'''11 March 2026''' - [[v1.86.0]] **'''Sack Noob''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{TheNarratorium|[[Fanatic]]|Wave 2|Sack Noob & [[Extra A]]|Wave 4|[[Builder]]|Wave 5}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
